newsitem.title: ITALY: Italians seize 60 kilos of heroin, Bulgarian held.
newsitem.headline: Italians seize 60 kilos of heroin, Bulgarian held.

text.p: Police in southern Italy said on Thursday they had seized 60 kilos (130 lb) of pure heroin and arrested the Bulgarian driver of the truck in which it was hidden.
The man, whom police named as Ivo Miladinov, 34, was stopped on December 28 at a motorway service area near Bari and the drugs were found during a search of the truck.
Police told a news conference that the heroin, believed to come from Turkey, had been concealed in a false compartment of the truck, which had been carrying wood.
They said the man arrived in Italy by ferry from Greece at the southern port of Brindisi on December 24.
Police put no street value on the drugs. Miladinov faced charges of international drugs trafficking.
